evidence.bullet: International New Arrivals arrive in the Jersey school system from outside the Island or the UK
evidence.quote: International New Arrivals (INAs): Students who arrive in the Jersey school system from outside the Island or the UK

evidence.bullet: A multilingual learner is any student with a language beyond English in their repertoire
evidence.quote: Multilingual Learner (MLL): Any student who has a language or languages beyond English in their linguistic repertoire

evidence.bullet: International New Arrivals sit an initial assessment in both home language and English
evidence.quote: International New Arrivals will complete an appropriate initial assessment in both home language (L1) and English (L2) if they do not have English as a home language or former language of schooling

evidence.bullet: Every school adopts an agreed assessment framework for tracking and reporting EAL proficiency
evidence.quote: All schools will adopt an agreed-upon assessment framework for tracking and reporting on EAL proficiency development

evidence.bullet: A home language different from the teaching language is not itself a learning difficulty
evidence.quote: A child is not to be taken as having a learning difficulty solely because the language (or form of the language) in which the child is, or will be, taught is different from a language (or form of a language) which has at any time been spoken in the child

sources.label: Language Policy for Jersey Education, Department for Children, Young People, Education and Skills, 2021
